entities.summary: Marty Joe Zambotto, known professionally as Go-Jo, is an Australian singer, songwriter, and record producer. He is best known for his song "Mrs. Hollywood" and his participation for Australia in the Eurovision Song Contest 2025 with the song "Milkshake Man".
